companyDescription: Defense autonomy/robotics software · exclusive US manufacturing & distribution partnership with Israel Aerospace Industries for loitering munitions, plus UAV/swarming work (AFRL HANGTIME) · FY26 revenue guided +357-415% YoY, backlog $24.6M
priceNote: Live $3.31 (+2.8%) on Nov 4, 2026, down ~8% from $3.60 at the Oct 26 report and just above the $3.21 52-week low (high $10.00). Market cap ~$164M. Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Oct 26, 2026). Q3 2026 results come before the open on Nov 10 (consensus EPS -$0.21, revenue ~$7.5M). They are the dated test of the FY26 guide for +357-415% growth and the $24.6M backlog. The real moonshot driver is still unconfirmed after three months: a US award for the Israel Aerospace Industries loitering munition. The stock sits ~3% above its 52-week low, and consensus is $10.75. The thesis is partnership-driven, and partnership_win is the measured Tier-2 LAGGARD in BOTH lanes (turbo -3.8pp vs +2.0pp overall, n=16; core -1.6 vs +1.4, n=12), so conviction and size are cut to 1.5%. Base +50% (~$5) assumes an in-line print with guidance held, over ~1-2 months, above the lane's realized 30-day P75 (+12.2%; Base bias +72.7pp). แนะนำ 1-2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า guide ถูกตัด ลงได้ 40-50%.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings — guide and backlog check
catalysts.description: Before market open; call 8:00 AM ET. Consensus EPS -$0.21 on ~$7.54M revenue. Watch whether FY26 revenue growth of +357-415% holds and the backlog ($24.6M at Q2) keeps building.

catalysts.name: IAI loitering-munition US contract
catalysts.description: Exclusive US manufacturing/distribution of Israel Aerospace Industries loitering munitions. No award, size or timeline has been disclosed since July; this is the event that would make the Moon case real.

risks: The IAI loitering-munition DoW contract is still unconfirmed: no award, size, or timeline after three-plus months.
partnership_win is the measured Tier-2 LAGGARD in both lanes (turbo -3.8pp vs +2.0pp, n=16; core -1.6 vs +1.4, n=12). October award headlines without dollar values didn't move the stock either.
Q2 missed on EPS (-$0.27 vs -$0.23). Another miss with a trimmed FY guide would undercut the whole re-rating story.
Runway is ~12-15 months on $43.7M cash (Jun 30) against $32-36M guided burn. Acquisitions could accelerate burn or require equity.
Pivoting from software/robotics into a vertically integrated defense contractor via M&A is a material execution change.

estimateDates.note: Pre-market; FY26 guide (+357-415%) and backlog are the tells
The Moon-case driver; no timing disclosed

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 (10–2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented for a hike). Futures price ~85% odds of another +25bp at the Dec 9 FOMC after Logan and Musalem called for more tightening; Warsh gave no explicit December signal.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Sep PCE: headline 3.6% y/y (+0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (+0.3% m/m); Q3 GDP +3.4% annualized. Oct CPI on Nov 10 is the next test — core ≥0.4% m/m would effectively lock in the December hike.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Small-cap defense tech. Defense budgets support demand, but the Nov 3 Democratic midterm sweep adds uncertainty to FY27 procurement priorities, and higher rates hurt cash-burning small caps.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Nov 10 print lands on CPI day. A Democratic Congress is a mild headwind for new defense-tech program starts, and a December hike weighs on cash-burning small caps.

postLose.note: Defense-tech small caps that cut guidance typically lose 10-20% on the day. Treat this as a sector rule of thumb, not a PDYN-specific precedent.

spotSizing.reason: 1.5%. The dated catalyst is earnings (earnings_beat n=2, context only), but the moonshot thesis is a partnership/contract win, and partnership_win is the Tier-2 LAGGARD in both lanes (turbo -3.8pp vs +2.0pp, n=16; core -1.6 vs +1.4, n=12). That warrants visibly lower size than the rest of this run.

comparableCases.note: A program-of-record defense award re-rated a sub-$200M drone company ~10x over ~13 months. This is the shape of PDYN's Moon case if the IAI award lands.
Forward guidance, not the print, moves PDYN. A raised FY guide on Nov 10 is the Bull path.
